This confirms the mechanism (text/event-stream, Server-Sent Events on `/api/v1/sse`) and hub implementation. Now I have everything needed to answer.

q20. mechanism: Server-Sent Events (SSE) over a long-lived HTTP connection at `/api/v1/sse` (handler in `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` sets `Content-Type: text/event-stream` and streams `data: ...\n\n` frames to the browser, with heartbeat pings); hub path: `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (the `SSEHub` type — `Subscribe`/`Unsubscribe`/`Broadcast` manage per-client buffered channels and fan out `SSEEvent` JSON payloads, filtered by visibility/role via `canReceive`); handler names that broadcast through it (all via `s.SSEHub.Broadcast(...)` on `*APIV1Service`):

- `CreateMemo` (`memo_service.go:163`)
- `DeleteMemo` (`memo_service.go:585`)
- `UpdateMemo` (`memo_service.go:513`, indirectly via the shared helper `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` in `memo_update_helpers.go:71`)
- `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:48`, same shared `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` helper)
- `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:48`, same shared `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` helper)
- `CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go:126`)
- `UpsertMemoReaction` (`reaction_service.go:106`)
- `DeleteMemoReaction` (`reaction_service.go:161`)
